$description: The full coding vocabulary referenced by data/sage-audit-schema.json enums. This is the canonical definition source -- audit records only ever store the short codes (e.g. MONO_KNOWLEDGE); this file is where a reader or a site's UI looks up what a code actually means. Previously this vocabulary existed only as prose bullet lists duplicated across decolonial-methods-audit-protocol.md, sage-methods-critique-v2 (1).md, and several draft .txt files -- consolidated here as the single source of truth.

tier_1_monocultures.framework: Boaventura de Sousa Santos (2014), sociology of absences -- [REF-SAN-2014]; [REF-SAN-2007]

MONO_KNOWLEDGE.name: Monoculture of Knowledge and Rigor
MONO_KNOWLEDGE.definition: Tags instructions that treat Anglo-American empiricist science and formal academic canons as the only valid criteria for truth, dismissing vernacular, oral, or spiritual knowledges as ignorant or unscientific.

MONO_TIME.name: Monoculture of Linear Time
MONO_TIME.definition: Tags requirements that enforce linear, chronological progression, labeling non-linear, relational, or ancestral temporalities as backward, obsolete, or residual.

MONO_CLASS.name: Monoculture of Naturalized Classification
MONO_CLASS.definition: Tags instances where racial, gendered, or institutional hierarchies are naturalized or treated as objective demographic categories rather than products of historical domination.

MONO_SCALE.name: Monoculture of the Dominant Scale
MONO_SCALE.definition: Tags pressure to abstract local realities into universal 'theoretical codes' or globalized frameworks, treating the local as merely parochial.

MONO_PRODUCTIVITY.name: Monoculture of Capitalist Productivity
MONO_PRODUCTIVITY.definition: Tags guidelines that measure value solely through output, efficiency, or commodified data, discarding non-extractive social relations as unproductive.

EXT_GENTRIFICATION.name: Knowledge Gentrification ("Flip and Fix")
EXT_GENTRIFICATION.definition: Tags guidelines instructing researchers to sanitize, translate, or 'renovate' raw, vernacular stories into respectable academic prose for publication markets.

EXT_VACUUM_PACK.name: Vacuum-Packing / NVivo-ization
EXT_VACUUM_PACK.definition: Tags procedures that de-contextualize oral accounts by converting them into prepackaged, de-identified, software-indexed data points.

EXT_STORYCIDE.name: Storycide (Historicidio) / Knowledge Captivity
EXT_STORYCIDE.definition: Tags the systematic discarding or locking away of participant narratives that do not fit the researcher's coding protocol.

EXT_ZERO_POINT.name: Zero-Point Hubris / "iCloud Researcher"
EXT_ZERO_POINT.definition: Tags passive, disembodied academic language ('the data indicates', 'findings reveal') that conceals researcher positionality, institutional privilege, and geopolitical location.

EXT_EAD.name: English Academic Discourse / Technical Mandate
EXT_EAD.definition: Tags mandatory enforcement of standardized English publishing norms, proprietary indexing software, or institutional research templates.

tier_3_historical_lenses.framework: Grosfoguel (2013) four genocides/epistemicides; Trouillot (1995) four moments of silence -- [REF-GRO-2013]; [REF-TRO-1995]

historical_lens_codes.HIST_AL_ANDALUS: The historic erasure of Arab-Islamic and Jewish intellectual traditions during the Reconquista.
historical_lens_codes.HIST_INDIGENOUS_GENOCIDE: The civilizational erasure, dispossession, and euphemistic classification of Indigenous peoples in the Americas.
historical_lens_codes.HIST_AFRICAN_ENSLAVEMENT: The ontological reduction, commodification, and archival muteness imposed by the Transatlantic slave trade.
historical_lens_codes.HIST_GENDER_WITCH_HUNTS: The systematic destruction of autonomous, embodied female knowledge practices during European witch trials.

silence_moment_codes.FACT_CREATION: Silence enters at the creation of sources -- what the textbook instructs researchers to treat as valid source material in the first place.
silence_moment_codes.FACT_ASSEMBLY: Silence enters at the creation of archives -- what gets indexed, digitized, or database-organized.
silence_moment_codes.FACT_RETRIEVAL: Silence enters at the creation of narratives -- how the textbook teaches coding and retrieval to shape what's 'found'.
silence_moment_codes.RETROSPECTIVE_SIGNIFICANCE: Silence enters at the creation of history -- what ultimately counts as qualitative canon.

tier_4_ecologies.framework: Santos (2014) five ecologies; Wolcott (2009); Kirk & Miller (1986) -- [REF-SAN-2014]; [REF-WOL-2009]; [REF-KIR-1986]

ECO_KNOWLEDGES.name: Ecology of Knowledges
ECO_KNOWLEDGES.definition: Restores plural, contextual ways of knowing alongside scientific paradigms, validated via Wolcott's Thick Description.

ECO_TEMPORALITIES.name: Ecology of Temporalities
ECO_TEMPORALITIES.definition: Restores cyclical, generational, or non-linear memory systems, validated via historical contextualization.

ECO_RECOGNITION.name: Ecology of Recognition
ECO_RECOGNITION.definition: Reclaims 'differences among equals' by de-naturalizing social hierarchies.

ECO_TRANSSCALE.name: Ecology of Trans-Scale
ECO_TRANSSCALE.definition: Reclaims site-specific, non-globalized realities -- 'des-globalizing' the local.

ECO_PRODUCTIVITIES.name: Ecology of Productivities
ECO_PRODUCTIVITIES.definition: Reclaims non-capitalist, reciprocal, and communal forms of knowledge generation.

validity_code.QUAL_VALIDITY: Cites explicit qualitative reliability criteria -- Kirk & Miller's synchronic/diachronic reliability, reflexivity logs, or communicative member-checking -- to defend the reconstructive reading.

tier_5_infrastructure_mechanisms.framework: NEW in v2 -- information science / critical data studies, paired discipline. See docs/audit-schema-guide.md for the design rationale. Grounded in master-reference-key.md Section 3 -- [REF-OLS-2002]; [REF-PAT-2021]; [REF-TRO-1995]; [REF-DUA-2015]; [REF-SUT-2021]; [REF-BER-1971].

full_text_indexing.name: Full-Text Indexing
full_text_indexing.definition: A search/indexing engine that flattens heterogeneous documents into one uniformly keyword-searchable corpus, discarding format, provenance, and language metadata in the process. Example in this audit: ZyIndex.

commercial_database_paywall.name: Commercial Database / Paywall
commercial_database_paywall.definition: A subscription-gated corpus where access control and the vendor's own proprietary classification scheme jointly determine what counts as available data. Example in this audit: LEXIS/NEXIS.

fixed_schema_data_collection.name: Fixed-Schema Data Collection
fixed_schema_data_collection.definition: A schema-on-write data model: fields/categories are defined before any data is collected, and every observation must be forced into a predefined slot or be dropped. Example in this audit: Altheide's precoded protocol variables.

qualitative_data_platform.name: Qualitative Data Analysis Platform
qualitative_data_platform.definition: Coding/tagging software (e.g. NVivo) that imposes its own internal data model -- nodes, cases, attributes -- onto narrative material as a condition of analysis.
qualitative_data_platform.status: placeholder -- referenced throughout the source documents (polanco et al.'s 'NVivo-ized' critique) but no textbook passage has yet been audited against it with a page citation. Candidate for the next record added to sage-audit-data.json.

controlled_vocabulary_classification.name: Controlled Vocabulary / Classification Scheme
controlled_vocabulary_classification.definition: Library/metadata classification systems (e.g. Library of Congress Subject Headings) whose fixed term lists determine what a text can be found under, and whose historical bias is documented in library and information science (Olson 2002, Berman 1971).
controlled_vocabulary_classification.status: placeholder -- the citation base (Section 3 of master-reference-key.md) supports this category, but it awaits its own audited textbook passage.

tier_6_nested_complicity.framework: Grounded in polanco et al. (2020), Tuck and Yang (2012), Maldonado-Torres (2017), and Spivak (1988) [REF-POL-2020]; [REF-TUC-2012]; [REF-MAL-2017]; [REF-SPI-1988]. These sources argue that a decolonial critique conducted through the apparatus it critiques does not thereby exit that apparatus.
tier_6_nested_complicity.scope_note: Applies to this project's own audit operation on a given unit, not to the audited text itself.

NEST_APPARATUS.name: Apparatus Reproduces the Coded Mechanism
NEST_APPARATUS.definition: Auditing this unit required the project to perform the same technical mechanism the unit is coded for.

NEST_STANDARD.name: Critiqued Practice Invoked as the Audit's Own Validity Standard
NEST_STANDARD.definition: The practice coded as a mechanism of erasure in this unit is also a standard this project relies on to defend its own reliability.

NEST_UNRESOLVED.name: Nesting Not Exitable Within Project Scope
NEST_UNRESOLVED.definition: No available alternative within this project's scope would avoid the mechanism named.
